mcqs.question: In which month and year did Pullampara become Kerala’s first fully digitally literate panchayat?
mcqs.explanation: Pullampara became Kerala’s first fully digitally literate panchayat in September 2022. September 2021 is the tempting incorrect option; the milestone was recorded one year later.

mcqs.question: According to the Census figure cited in the context of the Unique Disability ID system, what is the approximate population of persons with disabilities in India?
mcqs.explanation: The Census figure places India’s population of persons with disabilities at approximately 2.68 crore. The figure of 11 lakh refers to pending UDID applications, while 40% and 60% are percentages associated with UDID coverage and pending applications.
